About Me

The Engineer Who Thinks Like a PM

I'm a Mechanical Design Engineer transitioning into Product Management, with 3.5+ years building mission-critical UAV systems for defense applications — including Operation Sindoor and the IDEX program.

My edge as a PM candidate is rare: I've lived on both sides of the build. I understand technical constraints, FEA trade-offs, and manufacturing workflows — but I also deeply care about user problems, discovery, and data-driven decisions.

Currently a Product Management Fellow at Product Space, I've been applying JTBD, opportunity solution trees, PRDs, and success metrics to real-world case studies — and building AI-powered apps from scratch using Lovable, Stitch, and n8n.

Defense-grade precision

Designed drones deployed in Operation Sindoor. Structural integrity and reliability aren't just words to me.

AI-native product builder

Built two full prototype apps from scratch using Lovable, Stitch & n8n — shipped, not just ideated.

Systems thinker

From CAD-CAE-CAM pipelines to Opportunity Solution Trees — I see products as interconnected systems.

Research-first mindset

Every product decision starts with user research, JTBD interviews, and data — not assumptions.
